name: Manitoba Provincial Nominee Program (MPNP)
description: Skilled-worker streams of the Manitoba Provincial Nominee Program (MPNP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: For workers already in Manitoba; employer-driven
For people abroad with connections or invited in strategic recruitment

attributes.express_entry_aligned: Partly — 'enhanced' nominations go through Express Entry; candidates contacted by MPNP may be asked to create a profile
attributes.notes: 2026 allocation 8,000 nominations (6,239 in January plus 1,761 in August 2026). EOI draw #282 (October 2026): lowest score 816 for Skilled Worker in Manitoba.
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
